name: at the Cost of You
source:
The worth of your pseudo-solitude is revealed to you.
In this world, there are people who are unfortunate enough to get selected by the universe and get tested with their own desires.
And when they failed the trial, they absolutely get executed according to their number of sins.

The cycle of the unfortunate is to burn in their own sins, or free their unfortunate fellow from their suffering.

Lilia Galdeira was once that unfortunate person, and was once chose to become one of such 'heroes'.
Alas, it was now all in the past.

[From [url=https://usarin.itch.io/cost]itch.io[/url]]
